ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag to app.html
ideas.why: app.html really has no viewport meta, and adding it helps mobile rendering.

ideas.idea: Replace the quay.example placeholder domain in the sitemap, robots.txt and canonicals, ideally from one config value
ideas.why: The placeholder domain appears in all of those files, and real URLs are needed for canonicals and the sitemap to work.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod to the sitemap entries
ideas.why: It is accurate, but lastmod has little effect on a two-URL sitemap.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the free-delivery line
ideas.why: This reverses a deliberate scoped choice, even though the report hedges with 'if deliberate'.

ideas.idea: Wrap the delivery line in a footer or landmark and add an aria-label to the nav
ideas.why: This is accurate accessibility advice, but it would apply to almost any site and has little effect on discovery.

ideas.idea: Change the page titles to include the brand and keywords
ideas.why: The titles are already adequate, so rewording them has little effect and is mostly keyword stuffing.

ideas.idea: Add more text and links to products or categories on the home and shop pages
ideas.why: Both pages hold almost no content or internal links, so there is little for people or machines to understand.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter tags to pages
ideas.why: No page has them, but they only affect link previews and apply to nearly any site.

ideas.idea: Link to the search page from the nav or home page
ideas.why: /search is a deliberate noindex page, so promoting it with internal links works against that choice.

ideas.idea: Switch the shop Product JSON-LD to ItemList with per-product Product entries, or move Product markup to product pages
ideas.why: The shop page is a listing, and its single 'Bilge pump' Product markup misdescribes it.

ideas.idea: Build the JSON-LD with JSON.stringify and escape < as \u003c instead of using a raw {@html} string
ideas.why: This is sound hardening advice, but the JSON-LD here is static and the change has little effect.

ideas.idea: Add Organization or WebSite JSON-LD in the layout
ideas.why: The layout has no site-wide structured data, and this would help search engines and AI systems identify the brand.
llms.txt is not a way to be found, and the brief says its absence is not a problem.

ideas.idea: Add explicit AI-crawler rules to robots.txt
ideas.why: The report itself says the * group already allows everything, so extra rules add little.

ideas.idea: Add factual content for AI to quote, such as specs, delivery and returns terms, product descriptions and an FAQ with FAQPage markup
ideas.why: A mandatory FAQ with FAQPage markup is folklore, and the advice is not tied to anything the site actually has.

ideas.idea: Use prerender = true for static pages
ideas.why: The routes are all static, so prerendering fits and fixes the empty server shell.
